propositions: Register `identity` as an exempt ticket-type (mirroring session_log/code_review) at all required registration sites (schema, types, composer, reducer, gates, reconciler, orchestrator).
Implement `rebar identity create` CLI command and library function to mint a single CREATE event carrying name, email, provider mappings, and OpenSSH public keys.

Implement `resolve_current_identity()` resolver that reads `.rebar/current_identity` pointer file when present, falls back to git config user.email matching, and returns None for all invalid states (no email, subprocess error, zero/multiple matches, dangling pointer).
Ensure identity tickets are exempt from lifecycle gates, graph inclusion, Jira sync, and default list operations (identical posture to session_log).
`rebar show <identity_id> --output llm` renders name, email, mappings, and keys fields in structured JSON.
`rebar identity use <id>` writes the identity pointer; `rebar identity create --self` writes pointer to the newly-created identity in one invocation.
